caption:
What does it mean to trust someone?

Check out the full episode of @cornerpiecepod, at the link in @TED’s bio.
transcript: Maybe this is weird, but I don't trust my friends. Yeah, but I feel like you don't trust anyone. I think I'm really shocked to hear you say that you don't trust the both of us because we've been running a thing together for so many years and you don't trust us. I think I only trust people when their interests and incentives align with mine. That's not trust! Then what is it? So I asked an expert. So the way I define trust is that it's a confident relationship with the unknown. That's why the people I really trust in my life, I don't need to know what they're up to. And then the people that I really struggle to trust, I kind of need to control them. Because you're trying to minimize the unknown because you don't have a confident relationship with the unknown. Exactly. Is trust rational? No! But I feel like my version of trust is rational. There's not going to be every situation in your life where you can look at incentives, interests and motives. There's going to be situations where you have to trust. When should we trust each other? This week on Cornerpiece.

caption: When a couple creates their own world together, love thrives, says social psychologist @elijfinkel. In his TED Talk, he explores why so many of us struggle to be our true selves in relationships and shares the secret of what the happiest couples do differently. Visit the link in our bio to learn more.
transcript: Imagine you just died. You need to get your spouse a message that could save their life. Here's the problem. The only person who can hear you is Whoopi Goldberg? Yes, it's true. This is the plot of the movie Ghost. But imagine that's you. What could you say in just a few urgent seconds that would convince your spouse it's really you? Patrick's first attempt fails. Tell her I love her. Too obvious. Too generic. But then he knows it's just one word. Ditto. Because ditto was their secret code for I love you. Something that only made sense inside the private world the two of them had built together. I think of that private world as a relationship's love motif. A phrase gets repeated. A joke sticks. A ritual forms. And a private world takes shape. Two people across countless tiny interactions building something that never existed before. Couples who leaned more strongly into their love motif were happier. And in fact, those who leaned more strongly into their love motif on a given day were happier than on days when they didn't lean as much into it. Turns out it's not just about date nights. It's about savoring your private world together. Someday, one of you will be gone. And the other will be left holding a hundred tiny symbols that mean nothing to anyone else and everything to you. Please, while there's still time, build your love motif so when it matters most, one word will be enough.

caption:
If you want to get offline and reconnect with your community, actor and director Bryce Dallas Howard (@brycedhoward) says to be more intentional with what — and when — you post on social media. Stay tuned for more tips like these from our [re]connect series.

[Made possible with the support of Visit Greater Palm Springs @visitgreaterps]
transcript: If you want to get offline and reconnect with your community, establish a two-day delay with your post. You want your post to be intentional, not reactive. So I recommend a two-day delay where you wait, you pause, you're present to whatever the experience was. And you can think about, okay, why do I want to post? How is this going to serve my community? How is this going to serve my family? These are things that are important to be aware of and intentional about. Since I stopped feeling the pressure to post immediately, I feel so much better. The pressure to post was really something that I was putting on myself. When I post intentionally, I'm excited. I'm excited to share. I'm not wracked with anxiety about what the impact is going to be. If you engage at all in social media, you have a platform to the public. And that's an incredibly powerful and empowering opportunity. It's also a lot of pressure, and you don't need that in every single circumstance in your life. By waiting 24 to 48 hours, those posts will be intentional, and you'll be proud of them. And they'll leave a legacy behind and tell your story in a way that you feel good about.

caption:
Dos mangas de agua se formaron frente a la costa de Capri, en Italia 🇮🇹

También conocidas como trombas marinas, son columnas de aire y agua que giran sobre el mar, de forma similar a como lo hacen los tornados en tierra.

Es un fenómeno poco habitual. 

Aunque pueden aparecer en distintas épocas del año, son más frecuentes a finales del verano y durante el otoño.

Las dos mangas de agua aparecieron cerca de las emblemáticas formaciones rocosas de los Faraglioni.

#Italia #Mangadeagua #Capri #Naturaleza #BBCMundo

Because if we can tell a better story about democracy, we can tell a better story about America, where our politics isn't zero-sum, right? I win, you lose. Because the big tribe that is America, the big tribe that's predicated on our democratic values, that tribe is big enough and strong enough and expansive enough to hold all the other little tribes inside of it, from your progressive Bernie bros to your evangelical Christians to your basic lesbian Republicans.

caption: Are you in your dream job? For many people, the answer is no. Here’s what venture capitalist Bill Gurley (@bgurley) has to say about it. Watch his full talk at the link in bio.
transcript: We asked people, are you in your dream job and do you want a do-over? And only 20% said, yes, I'm in my dream job and I don't need a do-over. So maybe it's as low as one in five, 20%. Why isn't it better? I think there are a few issues. First, I think the path to and through college is broken. I think it's because it's schools are so damn hard to get into. In sixth grade, we begin with Jonathan Haidt, his term, the resume arms race. We do Mandarin lessons, lacrosse lessons, cello lessons, volunteering, and that's just by Tuesday. The kids feel pressure and the parents feel pressure, and I think we know something's wrong there. Second, we've moved the decision goalposts. When I was young, they wouldn't allow you to declare a major until the end of your sophomore year of college. Today at many schools, you have to apply to the major when you fill out the application. We made the life decision from 20 years to 17 years old. Have you ever asked a 17-year-old what they want to do the rest of their life? The last thing is, several well-intentioned parents and advisors, and I want to repeat, well-intentioned, have pushed kids towards the safe jobs, medicine, legal, finance, comp sci. But what if the safe jobs aren't safe anymore? Along comes AI. And I don't think it's the jobs we love that are under threat. It's the ones people were ambivalent about already. But maybe, maybe what's really under threat is the static mindset.

🇺🇸 Aterrizaje de emergencia.

Una pequeña aeronave se vio obligada a descender a la vía pública en el suroeste de Florida tras sufrir un fallo mecánico.

Las imágenes del incidente muestran cómo el avión roza el asfalto e impacta contra la parte trasera de una camioneta pickup en movimiento antes de detenerse por completo.
 
A pesar de lo aparatoso de la maniobra y de la presencia de vehículos en ese momento, la oficina del sheriff confirmó que ninguna persona resultó herida.

Las autoridades han iniciado una investigación para determinar las causas de este accidente mecánico.

caption:
El CEO de la empresa más valiosa del mundo ✅ Infidelidad ✅ Una presunta espía china ✅

Es la trama que envuelve al CEO de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, considerado rockstar del mundo empresarial, y que ha estado a la cabeza por 30 años de NVIDIA, una empresa que es estratégica ahora mismo en la batalla campal por el dominio de la inteligencia artificial que libran principalmente China y Estados Unidos. 🎥

@anamariaroura te explica qué pasó.

#Nvidia #IA #InteligenciaArtificial #Tecnologia #China #EstadosUnidos
transcript: Esta es la trama que vuelve una infidelidad, una presunta espía china y a Jensen Wang, el CEO del gigante tecnológico Nvidia, la empresa más valiosa del mundo en la bolsa. Y la cosa es que habría pasado como un asunto más bien privado cuando Wang se disculpó ante su esposa, su familia y su empresa por tener un affair. Pero el tema es que el popular Wang, una especie de rockstar del mundo empresarial, ha estado a la cabeza por 30 años de Nvidia, una empresa que es estratégica ahora mismo en la batalla campal por el dominio de la inteligencia artificial que libran principalmente China y Estados Unidos. Nvidia, con un valor en el mercado de 4.5 billones de dólares, produce entre otras cosas semiconductores, ahora mismo un elemento clave en la industria tecnológica y provee de chips a empresas como OpenAI y Meta. Y para que tengas una idea del poder de este empresario estadounidense y de su influencia, un colega de la BBC contaba que podía hablar en la mañana con Trump y luego de unas horas con Xi Jinping. Bueno, resulta que su amante, Alice Wang, además de ser una exitosa empresaria, se sospecha que es también una espía para China. China dice que todo es especulación. Está vinculada a Megaspeed, una empresa de centros de datos con sede en Singapur que adquiere chips de Nvidia. Y el año pasado, las autoridades estadounidenses investigaron a esa empresa por presuntamente ayudar a empresas chinas a eludir las restricciones comerciales para acceder a chips de Nvidia. Pero luego, el diario The New York Times reportó que Trump había sido informado el año pasado de indicios de inteligencia que apuntaban a que Alice Wang estaba espiando para China. Según fuentes anónimas citadas por el diario, las agencias de inteligencia estadounidenses habían estado vigilando a Alice Wang y concluyeron que actuaba en nombre del gobierno chino. Ahora, la junta directiva de Nvidia anunció que iniciaría una investigación, aunque también aclaró que no tiene motivos para creer que se hayan visto comprometidos ni la seguridad nacional ni los secretos de Nvidia.

caption: Télécharger GTA sera si looonnngg mais dans certains pays, ce sera plus court. on t’explique. | Desk
transcript: Est-ce qu'il va falloir partir très loin pour jouer à GTA 6 dans les premiers ? La sortie tant attendue du jeu, c'est dans dix jours pour le 19 novembre, mais tout le monde ne pourra pas se promener à Vice City au même moment. Ceux qui ont précommandé GTA 6 pourront même déjà le télécharger cette nuit du lundi 9 au mardi 10 novembre avant de lancer le jeu la semaine prochaine. Mais vous ne mettrez pas le même temps pour télécharger les 212 gigas du jeu selon l'endroit où vous habitez. Par exemple, en France, ça devrait mettre 1h20 contre moins d'une heure à Singapour, alors qu'en Belgique, on annonce plus de 3h de téléchargement. Mais surtout, Rockstar Games, l'éditeur du jeu, a opté pour un lancement à minuit, heure locale dans chaque pays. Ça veut dire, par exemple, que les Néo-Zélandais seront servis les premiers alors que les Mexicains joueront en dernier 20h plus tard. C'est donc le retour du fameux New Zealand Trick. Les petits malins qui ont une Xbox pourront changer de paramètres sur leur console et se mettre sur le fuseau horaire de la Nouvelle-Zélande pour jouer dès midi en France. Malheureusement, sur PlayStation, c'est beaucoup plus compliqué. Il faut disposer d'un compte néo-zélandais séparé. Bref, d'ici le 19 novembre, il ne vous reste plus qu'à trouver un endroit avec une bonne connexion ou acheter une Xbox.
